description: Model tiers for persona chat (Owner decision 25/11/2026, docs/proposals/CHAT_KNOWLEDGE_CHARACTERS_2026-11-24.vi.md section 6). Code defaults and bounds; Admin may publish a replacement in public.ai_persona_model_tiers (migration 20261125100000). The SQL validator nilaza_private.ai_persona_model_tiers_errors mirrors these bounds; scripts/persona-model-tiers.test.mjs keeps them equal. The standard tier has no override: it uses the active persona_chat route and ai_feature_configs exactly as before tiers existed.

platform.description: Supabase Edge Functions, https://supabase.com/docs/guides/functions/limits (checked 25/11/2026): wall clock 150 s on Free, 400 s on paid plans; a request that sends no response within 150 s gets 504. The project is on Free, so a 300 s tier wait is capped to wallClockMs - safetyMarginMs until the plan changes and wallClockMs is published as 400000.
